name: A19 one-formula candidate T21 (MOGF, w = 0.1): T19's MOGC plus a halo-mass floor at the atomic-cooling scale
frozen_at: 2026-11-07 00:50 US Pacific, session SA73 overnight, after the T21 to T24 cross-validations
formula: M_ref = Mp/fb + 10^A (M*/1e10 Msun)^B (Re/3 kpc)^C + q M_Moster(M*, z), q = (M*/Mp)^50 / (1 + (M_t/M*)^4); then M_halo = (M_ref^8 + M_min^8)^(1/8), M_min = 1e8 Msun (fixed: virial temperature 1e4 K at z of 10 to 20, Johnson 2013); M_Moster: Moster, Naab and White (2013) with redshift evolution, inverted in [1e9, 10^16.5] Msun; NFW with dark mass (1-fb) M_halo inside r200 at the halo redshift, Dutton and Maccio (2014) c(M, z), satellites x (1 - 0.54 log10(D/r200,host)) (Moline et al. 2017); contraction M_DM(<r) = (1-fb) M_NFW(<r) max(F, 1)^s, F = 0.45 + 0.38 (eta + 1.16)^0.53, eta = M_bar(<r)/(fb M_NFW(<r)) (Cautun et al. 2020 eq. 11, contraction branch); dynamics M_bar(<r) = g_bar r^2/G, lensing M_p as a point mass; fb = 0.049/0.3175, h = 0.671

baryon_option_T24.what: MaNGA BCG stellar g_bar x alpha_IMF = 10^(0.38 log10(sigma/200 km/s) - 0.06 + 0.215): Posacki et al. 2015 IMF trend (relative to Salpeter), Chabrier conversion of Madau and Dickinson 2014; sigma = <sigma_los> of Tian et al. 2024 Table 1
baryon_option_T24.note: Changes the baryons, not the halo formula; needs a measured velocity dispersion
